# game probe summary

Seeds: 0..64; samples every 120 ticks.

Quantiles use linear interpolation. Day checkpoints are exact even when the sampling interval does not divide a day. Idle breach share is cumulative sampled breaches / sampled agents (including tick 0). Performance uses primary-engine tick wall time minus measured read-only census observer time / exact pre-tick agent count sum; run wall time includes census, I/O and optional twin validation. Agent-days integrate every pre-tick living count; social rate counts completed interaction pairs per agent-day. New actionable/unavailable metrics include hunger, thirst and fatigue with positive matching tile supply; old idle_with_breach remains hunger/thirst only.

## Death census

Every tick is observed, independently of raw sample frequency. Death rows use completed-tick numbering (first engine tick = 1). Needs/state are captured after decay, immediately before the lethal phase; partner liveness is measured at that phase boundary. A partner killed in the same lethal batch may therefore still be marked alive. Initially breached agents start their history at their first observation. No-breach history and missing water/home distances are null. Dominant-state ties use lexical order; state ticks include the breach observation. Inferred causes are checked against cumulative tallies every tick; a mismatch aborts the probe.
